newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Young started buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Young started buy.

text.p: -- JP Morgan said its analyst Matthew Harrigan started coverage of Young Broadcasting Inc with a buy rating.
-- Harrigan gave the stock price targets of $35 for year-end 1997 and $46 for year-end 1998. He estimated 1996 earnings at $0.13 a share and 1997 earnings at $0.34 a share.

-- The acquisition of KCAL could strongly boost Young Broadcasting, since the station is likely to benefit from higher ratings due to the Lakers' recent acquisition of "Madison Avenue icon" Shaquille O'Neill, he said in a research report.
